notes.title: WAIDH v.0.164 - Caving and Underground Update
notes.notes:
[b]WAIDH v.0.164[/b] (14524502) - Tuesday, 28/05/2024 ~22:08 GMT

[u]Changes in this version:[/u]
- Added a new item called Empty Glass Jar.
- Added a new item called Glowing Glass Jar.
- Added a new random generating map element called Glow Bug spawner.
[i]Glow Bug spawner only active at night time, which is between 18:00 and 06:00.[/i]
- Added new random generating Quests for Merchant AI NPCs at Trading Posts.
- Added new possible goods to purchase from Merchant AI NPCs at Trading Posts.
- Fixed collision check for rain drops - no more raining inside buildings or under trees.
- Added Auto Save option in Settings menu at Gameplay category.
- Fixed Mouse settings in Settings menu at Controls category.
- Added the random generating Cave spawner.
- Added a new Ammunition for Bows called Poisonous Arrow.
[i]Poisonous Arrow reduces enemy health by 35HP in 20 seconds.[/i]
[i]Switch between arrows by opening backpack then press use on the desired arrow.[/i]
- Added a new Tool called Headlight.
[i]Headlight can be crafted of a Flashlight and a Rope.[/i]
- Added 3 new Creatures as Cave Boss AI NPCs.
- Added a new special item called Artifact of the Shadow.
- Added a new special item called Artifact of the Truth.
- Added a new special item called Artifact of the Fear.
[i]These Artifacts can be obtained only by defeating then looting Cave Bosses.[/i]
- Fixed invisible blocking collision after death for Creatures.
- Added a new Creature called Giant Mosquito.
[i]Giant Mosquito is a friendly creature as long as you don't mess with it.[/i]
- Added a new Creature called Cave Bat.
[i]Cave Bat is an aggressive creature and it has a 50% chance to give you Poisoned effect when attacking.[/i]
- Added a new Creature called Cave Rat.
[i]Cave Rat is an aggressive creature and it has a 50% chance to give you Poisoned effect when attacking.[/i]
- Added a new Creature called Cave Scorpion.
[i]Cave Scorpion is an aggressive creature and it has a 50% chance to give you Crippled effect when attacking.[/i]
- Added a new Creature called Cave Spider.
[i]Cave Spider is an aggressive creature and it has a 50% chance to give you Crippled effect when attacking.[/i]
- Added a new Special item called Rat Tail.
- Added a new Special item called Scorpion Sting.
- Added a new Special item called Spider Leg.
- Added a new Special item called Bat Wing.
- Fixed a bug where native AI NPCs stuck under the landscape when they are outside of the render distance.
- Fixed native AI NPCs picked a wrong random quest outside of the Trading Posts.
- Improved existing and added extra hit box (headshot detection) for Creatures and native AI NPCs.
- Added a new Weapon called Enchanted Bow.
[i]Enchanted Bow can only be obtained by completing a special quest from the Merchant AI NPCs and then can be purchased from the Merchant AI NPCs at Trust level 100.[/i]
[i]Enchanted Bow is more durable than Primitive Bow and arrows shooted by the Enchanted Bow causing 15% more damage on enemies.[/i]
- Added the random generating double floors Maze spawner.
- Added a new Structure called Hard Metal Chest.
- Added a new Structure called Wooden Metal Chest.
- Fixed head rotation for player characters when Aiming with a Bow.
- No longer able to shoot an arrow or throw a spear while moving.
- Fixed a possible game crash when loading saved or generating new world tiles.
- Increased the maximum distance from 10.000m to 100.000m for Transmitters.
- Changed the possibility ranges for Random World Tiles for the World Generation.
[i][b]Important! Because of this update you will need to regenerate your world by typing: regen into the in-game console which can be accessed by Holding Right Shift + Enter![/b][/i]
[i]The regeneration process will destroy everything that has been randomly generated in the world and everything that you've placed or removed in the world![/i]
[i][b]For more information about World Regeneration please see the 'World Regeneration' channel on the official WAIDH discord server. [/b][/i]

+++ Added [b]14 new screenshots[/b] to the game's Store Page!

+++ Developer's Birthday SALE ( [b]29% OFF[/b] ) between [u]29th May - 30th May[/u] 2024!

[b]Want to know what's next?[/b]
Join the WAIDH Official Discord server and check out the channel called "upcoming".

notes.title: WAIDH v.0.163
notes.notes:
[b]WAIDH v.0.163[/b] (14073969) - Tuesday, 16/04/2024 ~20:30 GMT

[u]Changes in this version:[/u]
- Added a new Structure called Primitive Fence.
- Added more random generating cosmetics to Hostile Native Villages.
- Performance optimizations for AI NPCs and Foliage Generation.
- Fixed game crash caused by the random generating Trading Post spawner from previous update.
- Fixed dropped item name was empty for Earthenware.
- Fixed wrong positioning angle when building mode is active.
- Removed positioning delay when building mode is active.
- Fixed Inventory Component reference was inaccessible for Item Info UI.
- Added a new item called Water Jug.
- Added a new random generating map element called Waterfall.
[i]Waterfall can be found close to Trading Posts.[/i]
[i]Water Jug and Water Bottle can be filled up with fresh water at Waterfall.[/i]
- Fixed structure name was empty for Adobe Windowframe.
- Added the Side Quest system for the Merchant AI NPC at Trading Posts.
- Added new random generating Quests for Friendly Native AI NPCs, including the Merchant.
- Added a new consumable item called Potion of Toughness.
[i]Potion of Toughness gives 180 seconds of Endless Stamina Effect.[/i]
[i]This potion is considered as a rare item that can be obtained only from specific Quests as Reward item or can be purchased from Merchant AI NPCs.[/i]
- Added a new consumable item called Potion of Life.
[i]Potion of Life gives 180 seconds of Health Regeneration Effect.[/i]
[i]This potion is considered as a rare item that can be obtained only from specific Quests as Reward item or can be purchased from Merchant AI NPCs.[/i]
- Added a new consumable item called Water Lily Flower.
- Added a new structure called Cauldron.
[i]Cauldron has 45% chance to spawn at Hostile Native Villages at the Campfire.[/i]
- Updated Loot Table for random generated Chests, Backpacks and other Storages.
- Fixed missing animation when Hostile Native AI is attacking with a Stone Mace.
- Added loot function for Hanging Skeletons at Hostile Native Villages.
